entwurf.beschreibung: Microsoft Qlib bundles data handling, supervised and reinforcement learning for quantitative research. Its RD‑Agent auto‑mines factors and optimizes models, reducing manual coding and speeding experimentation.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Try automating research with Qlib and free up your time today, and watch progress.
teile.szene: A sleek office desk. Light filters through blinds. A laptop screen displays Qlib code. A hand slides a coffee cup into the frame. The background hums with a quiet hum of a server room.

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: Managing market data and training models manually is slow and error‑prone, especially during market shocks, leading to missed opportunities.
teile.szene: A cluttered desk with stacks of data sheets and a blinking monitor. A trader looks frustrated at a slow-loading chart. The clock ticks loudly, emphasizing time pressure.

teile.name: Tool
teile.text: Qlib bundles data processing, supervised learning, and reinforcement learning into one framework, simplifying deployment and reducing code.
teile.szene: A clean, organized workspace. A laptop shows a Qlib dashboard. A hand drags a widget to the screen. The background has a wall calendar marked with project milestones.

teile.name: Demo
teile.text: Its RD‑Agent tool auto‑mines factors and optimizes models in seconds, cutting research cycles by half.
teile.szene: A screen recording of RD‑Agent interface. The tool processes data in real time, showing graphs and metrics updating instantly. The camera zooms in on the automation script running.

teile.name: Benefit
teile.text: You gain faster, reproducible insights and reduce manual coding time, freeing resources for strategy refinement.
teile.szene: A satisfied researcher smiles at a monitor displaying backtesting results. The screen shows a green arrow upward, indicating success. Behind, a whiteboard lists next steps.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.text: New releases lock recorder loads; verify permissions before upgrading, or face training failures.
teile.szene: A terminal window shows an error message. A person looks concerned, holding a coffee mug. The screen highlights permission flags and warnings.

teile.name: CTA
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video for future reference.
teile.szene: A hand presses the like button on a video player. The screen displays a share icon. A calendar icon shows a saved date. The background is a neutral studio wall.
